title: Autodesk named-object dictionary owner crosswalk and generated control
mode: primary-source research with focused local test-control refinement

sources.observation: MLINESTYLE group 330 points to its owner dictionary and is documented as the ACAD_MLINESTYLE entry of the named-object dictionary.
TABLESTYLE group 330 identifies the ACAD_TABLESTYLE dictionary entry in the named-object dictionary.
MLeaderStyle creation and lookup use the ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE dictionary, confirming a dictionary container between the NOD and style object.
The database API returns the MLeader-style dictionary in the named-object dictionary.
The API documentation states that ACAD_DETAILVIEWSTYLE and ACAD_SECTIONVIEWSTYLE NOD keys open dictionaries containing their corresponding typed style objects.

The example enumerates ACAD_SCALELIST, ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME, ACAD_MLINESTYLE, ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE, ACAD_TABLESTYLE, detail/section view styles, and AcDbVariableDictionary as NOD dictionary children with named entries beneath them.

planImpact.implementationSummary: Corrected the generated callback control to model the Autodesk-documented NOD-to-family-dictionary-to-record ownership graph, including AcDbVariableDictionary. Removed an overstrict expectation that a valid, collision-free TABLESTYLE source handle must be remapped; the test continues to require graph identity and owner closure.

method.limitations: Autodesk documentation establishes these object-container routes but does not qualify every DWG-version payload or consumer behavior. No external drawing was downloaded or used, and no claim was made about unreviewed object families.
